changes.why: A page's link name is "marker" now; "anchor" places what is on a page up or down it.
A book without a name took the translation guide.<namespace>.<path>.name in 2.x; in 3.0 it is folios.<namespace>.<path>.name.
The cover's colour, picture, model and lettering are one group: "cover": {"color", "texture", "model", "text"}; the boards' texture is "textures" › "boards".
How a handheld book is held is in "handheld".
How a handheld book is held is in "handheld".
How a handheld book is held is in "handheld".
Whose reading a book keeps is "progress_scope": "player" or "copy".
The book item's model is "models" › "item".
The colours of a book's tooltips and toasts are "panel".
Colours are written "#RRGGBB" or "#AARRGGBB".
Colours are written "#RRGGBB" or "#AARRGGBB".
An entry's text is a page like any other: "pages": ["..."].
An entry's category is the folder it is in, entries/<category>/; "category" is gone.
One key per thing shown, taking one or a list: "recipe".
One key per thing shown, taking one or a list: "image".
One key per thing shown, taking one or a list: "structure", "build".
The words a thing is shown by are its "label".
A spread's blocks written in place are "multiblock"; "build" names a build file; a map place's words are its "label".
Conditions say what they follow: read, read_category, read_book, carried, obtained, quest, goal.
A lock is "requires": one condition or a list of them, written as quest objectives are; "secret" stays.
